heading: INT. CONSERVATORY, FINCH-HATTON HOUSE - EARLY MORNING

units.text: INT. CONSERVATORY, FINCH-HATTON HOUSE - EARLY MORNING
Glass walls beaded with dew.
Orchids hang from iron hooks.
Rain taps the roof like fingernails on a table.
A white sheet covers something long on the tiled floor.
INSPECTOR OSWIN PELLEGRINI, fifties, rumpled tweed, a pipe he does not light, stands over the sheet.

Around him wait the household: LADY CORDELIA FINCH-HATTON, seventy, upright in a wheelchair; AMOS TREVELYAN, the butler, pale as candle wax; MRS. BERNADETTE QUILL, the cook, wringing a dishcloth; and JASPER, the nephew, twenty-two, slouched against a palm.
Nobody leaves.
units.name: PELLEGRINI

units.text: We were having breakfast.
units.name: JASPER

units.text: Then you may have it later.
units.name: PELLEGRINI

units.text: He crouches.
He lifts the corner of the sheet and lets it fall.
Lady Cordelia grips the arms of her chair.
The cook turns her face to the glass.
No sign of a struggle.
units.name: PELLEGRINI

units.text: Inspector, if I might say.
units.name: AMOS

units.text: You might.
units.name: PELLEGRINI

units.text: The doors were locked at eleven.
units.name: AMOS

units.text: They were. I locked the kitchen.
units.name: MRS. QUILL

units.text: I locked nothing, I never lock anything.
units.name: JASPER

units.text: Be quiet, Jasper.
units.name: CORDELIA

units.text: Lady Finch-Hatton, who was the last to see him?
units.name: PELLEGRINI

units.text: I was. At half past ten.
units.name: CORDELIA

units.text: And?
units.name: PELLEGRINI

units.text: He was watering the orchids.
units.name: CORDELIA

units.text: Pellegrini rises, slowly, and goes to the nearest hanging basket.
He touches the soil with two fingers.
Dry.
units.name: PELLEGRINI

units.text: Jasper and Amos exchange a look.
Mrs. Quill drops the dishcloth.
Cordelia's wheels creak as she rolls backward half a foot, and then stops.
Whoever killed him watered the plants after.
units.name: PELLEGRINI

units.text: Silence.
Rain.
Then, softly, Lady Cordelia begins to laugh.
